collection.description: A child wonders how fish breathe underwater.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (adult), a naturalist, describes how gills take oxygen from water.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (child) asks why people cannot breathe the same way.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (child) watches gill movements without disturbing the fish.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The fish swims away before (child) can see clearly.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (child) learns that some sea animals breathe air.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (child) is surprised that dolphins must surface.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (elder) tells a story of fish borrowing the sea's breath as folklore.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (child) asks which parts are science and which are story.
